questions.q: Where do many elite graduates end up, and why?
a: Finance or consulting, because they feel lost
Nonprofits, because they want meaning
Academia, because they love research
Startups, because they crave risk
questions.why: Lesson 1 says nearly half of Harvard graduates enter those fields.

questions.q: Why do elite colleges end up run like businesses?
a: Research brings in the funding they need to grow
They admit every applicant who can pay
They reward professors for great teaching
They refuse to raise tuition each year
questions.why: Lesson 2 says budgets go to research that generates more revenue.

questions.q: What did the rising average GPA at Harvard suggest?
a: Grades were inflated and added pressure to perform
Students had become far more talented
Exams had grown much harder
Professors graded more strictly
questions.why: Lesson 2 questions a 3.43 average on a 4.0 scale.

questions.q: What was college originally meant to provide?
a: Time to think critically and discover what you want
Job training for a specific career
A network of wealthy alumni
Credentials for elite employers
questions.why: Lesson 3 says college should be a break for self-discovery.
